mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT space_id FROM bbx_material WHERE space_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted = 1
and tenant_id =#{tenantId}

SELECT stock_quantity AS totalNum, material_name AS name, CASE WHEN outbound_quantity = 0 THEN 0.00 ELSE ROUND((outbound_quantity * 1.0) / stock_quantity * 100, 2) END AS turnoverRate FROM bbx_material WHERE deleted = 1 AND material_type IN (2,3)
and tenant_id =#{tenantId}
ORDER BY turnoverRate DESC
ORDER BY turnoverRate asc
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT stock_quantity AS totalNum, material_name AS name, CASE WHEN (original_stock + inbound_quantity) = 0 THEN 0.00 ELSE ROUND(outbound_quantity / ((original_stock + inbound_quantity) * 1.0) * 100 , 2) END AS useRate FROM bbx_material WHERE deleted = 1 AND material_type = 1
and tenant_id =#{tenantId}
ORDER BY useRate DESC
ORDER BY useRate asc
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stock_status != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / (COUNT(*) * 1.0) * 100 END, 2 ) AS rate FROM bbx_material WHERE deleted = 1
and tenant_id =#{tenantId}
